title: Remove tracker ids from the header comment of src/engram_check_paths.rs
outcome: The header comment of src/engram_check_paths.rs (line 2) cites tracker ids ("Engram w-108a13d58018 criterion 2, tm-winf step 2"). The Engram section of CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md forbids Engram or Beads ids in source comments. The comment came in with commit 5fee74f, and the earlier comment-only cleanup missed it.
acceptance: src/engram_check_paths.rs carries no Engram or Beads id in any comment; the header still says what the module owns in plain words; a search of src/ for w-[0-9a-f]{12} and tm-[a-z0-9]{4} in comments finds none introduced by this change
